E2-2020-T2-P1-S1.trunk: S+系动词+表语从句：It is true that CEO pay has gone up（首席执行官薪酬上涨是事实）
structure: 形式主语结构：It is true
└ 真正主语从句(that)：CEO pay has gone up
├ 破折号补充：top ones may make 300 times the pay of typical workers
└ 并列分句(and)：since the mid-1970s, CEO pay ... has gone up by about 500%
E2-2020-T2-P1-S1.logic: that 从句是句子的真正主语；后面用两个量化信息分别呈现薪酬倍数和历史涨幅，支撑“上涨”这一判断。
notes: 300 times the pay of...：……薪酬的300倍。
by varying estimates：根据不同估算。
go up by 500% 指涨幅约为500%。

E2-2020-T2-P1-S5.trunk: 转折复句：It's not popular to say, but one reason... is that...（这种说法不讨喜，但一个原因是……）
structure: 分句①：It's not popular to say
├ 定语从句〔省略 why/that，修饰 reason〕：their pay has gone up so much
└ 表语从句(that)：CEOs really have upped their game
└ 比较状语：relative to many other workers in the U.S. economy
E2-2020-T2-P1-S5.logic: but 将舆论接受度与作者解释转折连接；one reason...is that 是核心因果框架，relative to 给出比较基准。
notes: up one's game：提高能力或表现。
reason 后省略的关系词在定语从句中作状语。

E2-2020-T2-P1-S17.trunk: 被动主句 + 同位解释：The highest CEO salaries are paid to outside candidates..., another sign that...（最高薪酬给外部人选，这是……的又一迹象）
structure: 主句：the highest CEO salaries are paid to outside candidates
└ 对比插入：not to the cozy insider picks
└ 同位语从句(that)：high CEO pay is not some kind of depredation
└ 介词短语：at the expense of the rest of the company
E2-2020-T2-P1-S17.logic: 外部候选人和内部熟人形成对比，同位语 another sign 将这一事实转化为反驳“掠夺说”的证据。
notes: cozy insider picks：关系亲密的内部人选。
at the expense of：以……为代价。
